notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 declaration-management surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador API and standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies object and interaction publication, active and passive subscription, withdrawal, pre-connect and pre-join service boundaries, and invalid declaration-handle failures without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object and interaction publication/subscription lifecycle
